content.text: In Zimbabwe, a country plagued by financial isolation, [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-3|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/why-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-only|digital]] creators were forced to abandon [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-5|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and other payment platforms due to restrictions. The need for an alternative solution led to the development of COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, powered by GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments. This infrastructure allows digital creators to build and deploy their own crypto stores, free from the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure's strength lies in its ability to decentralize payment processing through NOWPayments, eliminating the need for traditional payment gateways. With this setup, digital creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and enjoy low transaction fees, making it an attractive alternative to Stripe and other platforms. This infrastructure's flexibility and scalability also make it ideal for creators who want to expand their businesses without relying on a single payment platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy COREMERCH's infrastructure, you'll need to have a basic understanding of digital commerce and payment processing. You'll also need to have a domain name and a GitHub or Cloudflare account. Additionally, you'll need to install the required tools and scripts, including NOWPayments and the Sovereign Blueprint. Once you have these prerequisites in place, you can begin the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments to work with your chosen cryptocurrency. You'll also need to set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to securely deliver your digital products to customers. Additionally, you'll need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to protect your email and prevent spam. With these settings in place, you'll be able to process payments and deliver your digital products to customers securely and efficiently.
With COREMERCH, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and enjoy low transaction fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, you'll need to deploy your COREMERCH infrastructure and configure it to work with your chosen payment method. You'll also need to test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling your digital products to customers. With COREMERCH, you can deploy your infrastructure in as little as 4-6 hours, getting you up and running quickly and efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?' The answer is yes, with COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, you can host your digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, giving you the flexibility to choose the platform that best suits your needs. This infrastructure allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and enjoy low transaction fees, making it an attractive alternative to traditional payment platforms.
By using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy your COREMERCH infrastructure in as little as 48 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more advanced solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. To learn more about COREMERCH's products and solutions, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my COREMERCH infrastructure?

To integrate NOWPayments with your COREMERCH infrastructure, follow the instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to integrating NOWPayments with GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages.
Can I use a different file delivery system than Google Drive or Cloudflare R2?
Yes, you can use a different file delivery system, such as Dropbox or Amazon S3, as long as it meets the requirements of your COREMERCH infrastructure.
How do I configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for my COREMERCH infrastructure?
To configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for your COREMERCH infrastructure, follow the instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to configuring these settings.
Can I deploy my COREMERCH infrastructure in less than 4-6 hours?

Yes, with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy your COREMERCH infrastructure in as little as 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
How do I scale my COREMERCH infrastructure once it's running?

To scale your COREMERCH infrastructure once it's running, monitor your traffic and adjust your settings accordingly, and ensure that your payment and delivery pipeline can handle increased traffic and demand.
With COREMERCH, you can scale your infrastructure quickly and easily, without having to worry about the technical complexities of payment processing and delivery.
